description: Declared mutants of the naming guard's namespace roots (v8-arch-gyo2-namespace-root; rebuild-naming N17, naming DI 1; ids nm-). The guard is tests/common/kernel/naming_guard.py; its older mutants stay in the kernel, orchestration and world_time lists (ks-n1-*, ks-n3-*, or-guard-*, wt-guard-real-*). A self-test mutant is killed only when the named test case fails; a real-tree mutant when the guard prints the named finding. The adversarial check (another model, read-only) is recorded in the dev_log.
